fact.title: India has no right-to-disconnect law
fact.claim: India has no law that lets you ignore work messages after hours. A private member's bill was tabled in Dec 2025.
fact.law: A bill only. It is not law.

script.cover_1: 11 pm and your boss messages. Does any law cover this?
script.payoff: Reports say no law lets you ignore after-hours messages, so agree on times.
script.caption: With no law to lean on, a clear agreement is your best protection. Send this to the one whose phone buzzes at bedtime.
script.situation: Can your boss message you at night and expect a reply?
script.answer: Reports say no law lets you ignore work messages after hours. A bill was tabled in Dec 2025.
script.reply_me: I will reply to work messages by 10 am. Can we agree nothing before then is urgent?
